title: MongoDB Atlas for Government Achieves FedRAMP® Class D (High) Certification, Adds Support for Microsoft Azure Government
summary: Certification brings production AI on real-time operational data to high-impact federal workloads, across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 19, 2026—** MongoDB, Inc. (NASDAQ: MDB) today announced that MongoDB Atlas for Government has achieved FedRAMP® Class D (formerly known as FedRAMP High) Certification and added support for Azure Government. This makes Atlas for Government the only FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified cross-cloud operational database in the world, giving federal, state, and local agencies the option to run on the cloud provider of their choice.


With this certification, agencies no longer have to settle for single-cloud, Cloud Service Provider-native databases for high-impact transactional workloads. The same database, the same APIs, and the same operational model run unchanged on AWS, Microsoft Azure Government, or Google Cloud, so agencies can deploy on whichever cloud the mission requires, move between clouds as mandates or contracts shift, and avoid re-architecting applications every time a workload moves. FedRAMP Class D (High) is the program's highest certification class, reflecting the level of assurance and ongoing commitments provided to federal agencies for cloud services that process unclassified government data. Agencies evaluate the certified service, its configurations, and applicable controls to determine suitability for their specific workloads.


“Government agencies have long had to trade multi-cloud flexibility for the highest security assurance, because that assurance came through a single cloud’s native database", said Devin Pratt, Research Director, Data Management, IDC. “Certifying the same database at FedRAMP Class D (High) across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud removes that trade-off, giving agencies one data foundation they can carry across clouds as mandates shift, and use to put AI to work on sensitive data without re-architecting. That is exactly the kind of simplification that speeds modernization.”


"Government agencies are under enormous pressure to modernize and adopt AI while meeting the strictest security requirements in the industry," said Ben Cefalo, Chief Product Officer, MongoDB. "With FedRAMP Class D (High) now available across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, agencies can modernize and build AI applications on one database, whichever cloud they choose. No other operational database offers that same freedom today at the FedRAMP Class D (High) level. This is only the beginning of our investment in serving the public sector."


This certification is another step in MongoDB’s investment in the public sector. In May 2026, the company acquired Clarity Business Solutions, which has supported highly classified U.S. government workloads since 2021, adding federal domain expertise and security clearances to MongoDB’s public sector practice. MongoDB is giving agencies the tools and the expertise to modernize mission-critical systems with confidence.


Agencies are being asked to modernize, adopt AI, and keep mission-critical data protected and available, all at once. Atlas for Government helps with three of the toughest parts:


-


**Put AI to work on mission data, securely:** Agencies want AI that uses their own data without moving it outside a certified boundary. Native vector search lets teams build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications directly inside the FedRAMP Class D (High) environment, alongside the operational data they already run.


-


**Protect sensitive data without locking teams out:** Agencies shouldn’t have to choose between protecting sensitive records and using them. MongoDB Queryable Encryption encrypts selected sensitive fields in the application before they reach the database and enables supported queries without the database server decrypting those fields. Customers control key access through their chosen key-management configuration.


-


**Recover fast from outages and cyber incidents:** Automated Point-in-Time Restore (PITR) replaces manual, script-heavy backup routines, cutting disaster recovery restoration windows by up to 99% (for one customer, from 58 hours to under five minutes), so the mission keeps running.


Atlas for Government, an extension of MongoDB’s intelligent data platform, is available to federal agencies today, with more of the platform to follow. Atlas Agent Engine and Atlas Infinite, announced at Investor Day, are coming soon.


Agencies can get started with Atlas for Government at[https://www.mongodb.com/products/platform/atlas-for-government](https://www.mongodb.com/products/platform/atlas-for-government) . Developers and public sector vendors can start building today with Atlas for free at[mongodb.com/atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/products/platform) .


**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is the real-time, intelligent data platform for modern applications in the multi-cloud and AI era. Headquartered in New York, MongoDB helps organizations move faster, build smarter, and simplify complex architectures on a unified platform for operational data, search, real-time analytics, and AI-powered retrieval, coupled with MongoDB Voyage AI's industry-leading embedding and reranking models. The platform is available as a fully managed service with MongoDB Atlas or self-managed with MongoDB Enterprise Advanced or Community Edition. Millions of developers and more than 70,000 customers, including approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, rely on MongoDB for their most important customer-facing applications.
